---
title: "Specific site"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#to find out which sheets have data on the site WAV120

file <- here("data", "Pharmaceuticals infomation_V3.xlsx")

excel_sheets(file) %>%
  keep(~{
    dat <- read_excel(file, sheet = .x)
    "WAV120" %in% dat$Sample_Site_ID
  })
```
